name: get_order_status
description: Look up an order by its order ID. Returns the order status, items, total, carrier, tracking number, estimated delivery date, the delay reason for delayed orders, and the customer_id of the customer who placed the order. Use it for any question about where an order is, why it is late, or what it contains.

order_id.description: Numeric order ID, for example "123". Digits only, without '#' or other prefixes.
